America's best pizzerias crowned in 2026 rankings as experts debate regional bias and style.
Evidence: 50 Top Pizza list, expert analysis, NYC winner
#Food #Pizza

The annual 50 Top Pizza rankings highlight the finest pies across America, with New York City's Una Pizza Napoletana taking the top spot for the fifth consecutive year.

While culinary rankings celebrate exceptional craftsmanship, experts note inherent stylistic biases toward traditional Neapolitan pies over diverse regional American styles.
Resulting Judgement: (+0.6, +0.4) — Conditionally Sound

Food historian Colin Caplan examines the influence of 50 Top Pizza rankings, highlighting how regional traditions shape our national pizza landscape.

The Poison:
Elevating single styles risks overshadowing the vibrant, diverse regional pizza innovations thriving across American cities.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing a subjective stylistic preference (Q1 WHO/WHAT) with an objective culinary absolute creates unnecessary debate.

Social Physics Analysis:
This ranking operates on transparent appreciation of culinary craft, celebrating dedication without exploiting social divisions or manufacturing crises.

The Unavoidable Truth: Craftsmanship and quality ingredients define truly exceptional pizza.

The Unavoidable Lie: No single ranking can capture America's vast pizza diversity.

America's best pizzerias crowned in new rankings as pizza expert gives slice of skepticism

A New York City pizzeria tops the 50 Top Pizza list for 2026, but a pizza expert and historian tells Fox News Digital that the organization leans toward certain styles.

Connecticut-based pizza expert Colin Caplan examines the influence of Italy's celebrated 50 Top rankings and reveals why cultural preferences and distinct regional traditions make choosing a universal winner difficult.

Columbus Day commemorates a famous voyage across the Atlantic, but Americans don't have to travel nearly as far to discover some of the country's best pizza.

The 50 Top Pizza rankings of 2026 highlight restaurants from coast to coast, though what makes a pie worthy of the top spot is still a matter of taste.

New Haven, Connecticut-based food historian and pizza expert Colin Caplan told Fox News Digital that what constitutes the "best" pizza really comes down to personal preference.

AMERICA'S BEST-TASTING PIZZA CHAIN IS AN OLD-SCHOOL FAVORITE, SURVEY FINDS

Ranked lists such as those published by 50 Top Pizza are helpful for expanding palates and introducing people to restaurants and dishes to try, he noted, but there's usually some subjectivity at play.

"50 Top Pizza is a very well-respected Italian-based, chef-based site that really goes and finds what they think is the best," he said, but suggested the organization might have a slight bias toward certain pizza styles that align with its Italian roots, such as Neapolitan.

50 Top Pizza, a website run by Italian chefs, has released its 2026 ranked list of the best pizzerias in America. (iStock)

Ultimately, though, good pizza is all about the love that goes into it.

"If the heart is [in] it, the pizza is going to taste amazing," Caplan said.

These are the top five pizzerias in America for 2026, according to 50 Top Pizza.

Founded in 1996 by Anthony Mangieri, this New York City pizzeria has "a stand-up example of sit-down pizza," according to The New York Times.

AMERICA'S MOST AND LEAST EXPENSIVE PLACES TO ORDER PIZZA REVEALED IN NEW STUDY

Eater NY called the Margherita pie "a miracle of pizza development and evolution unlike any other Neapolitan pie in the world."

New York City's Una Pizza Napoletana (not pictured) placed first in the 50 Top Pizza rankings for five consecutive years. (iStock)

Mangieri personally makes each ball of dough by hand, the website says, and he shapes, tops and bakes every pizza himself.

This is the fifth year in a row that Una Pizza Napoletana has claimed the top spot in the 50 Top Pizza USA ranking. The restaurant also placed second in the 50 Top Pizza World 2026 ranking.

Operated by chef William (Sang Woo) Joo and his wife and partner, Jennifer So, Pizzeria Sei has been serving Tokyo-style Neapolitan pizzas since 2022.

RETRO PIZZA HUT DRAWS CUSTOMERS FROM HOURS AWAY AS 1980S NOSTALGIA SENDS SALES SOARING

The crusts are shaped using a crimping technique that, along with a quick baking time at high heat, leads to a unique, varied texture, the website states.

Tied for second place is Tony's Pizza Napoletana, a San Francisco establishment run by 13-time world pizza champion Tony Gemignani.

Two California pizzerias tied for second in the Top 50 Pizza rankings. (iStock)

In addition to Neapolitan, Tony's serves multiple styles of pizza, including Detroit, Sicilian, New York and Romana, among others. The pizzeria also placed fifth in the 2026 50 Top Pizza World ranking.

Chef and owner Dan Richer, a 2011 James Beard Foundation Rising Star Chef semifinalist, opened Razza in 2007.

The pizzeria garnered a three-star review in 2017 from The New York Times, and in 2019 it was given the distinction of Best Pizza in North America by 50 Best.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE NEWS

The restaurant prioritizes fresh, high-quality ingredients and focuses on constantly improving their technique.

"Each ingredient is hand-picked, down to the salt that goes on the pizza," according to its website.

Pizza is best when you can taste the love, says New Haven, Connecticut-based food historian and pizza expert Colin Caplan. (iStock)

Both the bread and butter are made in-house, the flour is milled nearby in Clifton, N.J., and a homegrown yeast culture is added to the crust.

Founded by Donna Baldwin and John Arena, Truly Pizza focuses on using fresh, seasonal ingredients and supporting local farmers.

At the two-story, open-air Dana Point location, guests can enjoy coastal scenery while dining on artisan pizzas — both round and square — ranging from classic cheese to umami mushroom.

TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ

The "menu is informed but not bound by tradition, and mindfully curated," the website says.

Truly Pizza also earned the No. 26 spot in the 2026 50 Top Pizza World ranking.

A concept by Italian-born chef Francesco Martucci, this pizzeria is where "wood-fired tradition meets South Florida energy," the website states.

America's best pizzerias in the 50 Top Pizza rankings hail from New York City, California, New Jersey and Miami. (iStock)

Situated in the Miami neighborhood of Wynwood, the restaurant offers a wide range of pizzas, from the tomato-forward Assoluto di Pomodoro, featuring San Marzano tomato mousse and roasted cherry tomato cream, to the Fior di Zucca Al Quadrato, which has zucchini cream and squash blossoms.

CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

Francesco Martucci's Miami restaurant earned the top spot in the 50 Top Pizza World ranking from 2019 to 2025.

Sadie Chafe is a writer on the Lifestyle team at Fox News Digital.
